SELECT 
    bp.player_id,
    SUM(bp.triple) as triple_sum
FROM batting_postseason bp
WHERE bp.player_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id 
    FROM batting_postseason 
    WHERE league_id = 'NL' AND player_id IS NOT NULL
)
AND bp.player_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id 
    FROM batting_postseason 
    WHERE round = 'WS' AND player_id IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY bp.player_id
ORDER BY triple_sum DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
